title: Loss Run
description: Canonical extraction target for a Loss Run (Fideon SPEC_00 LossRunDocument, doc_type 'lossrun'). The claims array is the key list field: a silently dropped row is both easy to produce and expensive to miss, so list recall and row completeness are measured separately from per-value accuracy (arch 5, 15).

valuation_date.description: The as-of date through which claim amounts on this report are valued, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not the policy effective or expiration date, and not the date the report was printed.
valuation_date.$comment: Deliberately distinct from effective_date - the two are easy to confuse and this is a named example in arch 17.

total_claims_reported.description: The claim count stated by the document itself, when it states one. Extract the stated figure rather than counting the rows.
total_claims_reported.$comment: Feeds the row-completeness cross-check in SPEC_09 - it is compared against the number of rows actually extracted.

claims.description: Every claim row on the report, in document order. Extract all rows, including closed and zero-value claims. A row omitted here is invisible to per-field confidence, so completeness matters more than per-value precision.

claim_number.description: The carrier's identifier for this individual claim. Not the policy number.

loss_date.description: The date the loss occurred, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not the date the claim was reported or closed.

status.description: The claim's current status, lowercased to one of the listed values. Map the document's wording onto these; output null if it states none.

paid.description: Amount paid to date on this claim, as a number without currency symbols or separators.

reserved.description: Amount currently reserved (set aside, not yet paid) on this claim.

total_incurred.description: Total incurred on this claim, normally paid plus reserved. Extract the document's stated figure rather than computing it.

description.description: The document's free-text description of the loss, if present.
